pack: Community Edition and Enterprise Edition request guards
description: Partial request-pattern mitigation. Rejects absolute/traversal file.path query values on repository file-write routes.
affected_versions: GitLab GitLab: 18.7 to <18.11.12, 19.0 to <19.0.9, 19.1 to <19.1.8, 19.2 to <19.2.6, 19.3 to <19.3.2; verify complete affected/fixed ranges and deployment prerequisites in the linked CNA/vendor records.
coverage: Rejects absolute/traversal file.path query values on repository file-write routes.
limitations: Only the declared request facts and bounded native matcher are covered. No vulnerable-deployment reproduction was performed. Direct-origin access, alternate routes/encodings and uninspectable facts remain outside this rule. Apply vendor fixes; this is not complete CVE protection.
false_positive_risk: Legitimate API callers using absolute file.path values are denied.
